session_check: amc relative to event_date 2026-11-04. The board meets 2026-11-04 and the release is expected 2026-11-05 at about 07:00 CET, before the Milan open. So the print sits in close(11-04) -> close(11-05), not in the sealed close(11-03) -> close(11-04) window. Evidence: the issuer's calendar (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-08/20260806_187988.pdf; https://group.bper.it/en/-/riunione-del-consiglio-di-amministrazione-per-l-approvazione-del-resoconto-intermedio-di-gestione-consolidato-al-30-settembre-2026); the invitation to the call on Thu 5 Nov 10:00 CET (https://www.emarketstorage.com/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-10/20261027_191040.pdf); and the eMarket timestamps of prior releases, each the morning after its board: Q3 2025 on 2025-11-06 07:00:12 (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2025-11/20251106_173922.pdf), Q1 2026 on 2026-05-07 07:00:05 after the 6 May board (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-05/20260507_183510.pdf), and H1 2026 on 2026-08-06 07:00:16 after the 5 Aug board (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-08/20260806_187984.pdf). The 2026-11-05 07:00 release time is an inference from this pattern; no filing states it.
